constantsNote: Place centre is the middle of the Yaba box in research/world-drive/03-real-lagos-map-pipeline.md (lat 6.49-6.53, lon 3.36-3.40). Gravity: WGS84 normal gravity (Somigliana formula) at 6.51 N, sea level. Air density: ideal gas law, p = 101325 Pa (ISO 2533 standard sea-level pressure), T = 27 °C (approximate annual mean for Lagos, not measured by us). Ground height is not stored here; it comes from the terrain data.
